subject: Request: Pelago Health availability exemption and commercial carve-out for pilot
messages:
From: Elliot Carlson <elliot.carlson@pelagohealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-12T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot SLO ask + draft SOW

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Pelago’s CTO is enthusiastic about trying Redwood for our sensitive notes ingestion pilot. Before legal signs anything, we need two commercial concessions to proceed to a pilot: 1) an availability carve-out for the first 6 months — Pelago requests a 99.5% availability target (instead of standard 99.95%) for the pilot period with a capped service credit schedule, and 2) a one-time commercial concession of 20% off committed capacity for Q1 of the pilot to help fund integration work.

I attached our redline of the SOW and a simple SLA table showing the requested availability bands. Our procurement team flagged data residency and audit logs as must-haves, which you covered in the call. If we can get an exec-level approval on the availability waiver and the concession, legal will finish the SOW and we can sign the pilot PO.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve these exceptions (or what counterproposal you would consider)? We’d like to start the pilot the week of Jan 11.

Thanks —
Elliot Carlson
Head of Integrations, Pelago Health
elliot.carlson@pelagohealth.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: Pelago_SOW_Draft_v3.pdf, Pelago_SLA_Table.xlsx
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: elliot.carlson@pelagohealth.com
Date: 2026-12-13T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot SLO ask + draft SOW — need deal desk / exec guidance

Forwarding Pelago’s ask — they want a 6-month availability carve-out to 99.5% and a 20% one-time discount on committed capacity for Q1. They have a pilot start target the week of Jan 11.

Quick read: Pelago is early-stage but a strategic customer in digital health; pilot will ingest PHI-like notes (they emphasize PII/PHI controls). Operational risk: lowering SLO below 99.8% materially increases exposure and sets precedent. Commercial impact: 20% one-time concession + potential lower pricing on renewals.

My recommended counterproposal for exec consideration (keeps us conservative):
- Pilot term: 6 months
- Availability: 99.8% for the first 30 days (initial onboarding window), move to 99.9% for days 31–90, 99.95% thereafter for the remainder of pilot.
- Service credits: sliding scale but capped at 5% of monthly fees per month; cumulative cap of 10% over the pilot.
- Commercial concession: 10% one-time credit on committed capacity invoiced in the first month (instead of 20%).
- Require SSO + KMS + audit logs retention (as standard) + weekly health report.

If deal desk + finance want to trade more discount for a higher binding commit (12-month minimum) we can consider up to 15% but that’s outside pilot scope. Also legal noted we should avoid long-term precedent unless covered by an exception memo.

Please advise — specifically need (A) approval for any availability deviation and (B) signoff on concession % (if any). If approved, I’ll send a narrow redline for signature and loop in legal.

—Sean
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-14T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot SLO ask + draft SOW — deal desk recommendation and financials

Marissa / Sean —

Reviewed Pelago’s request and Sean’s suggested counter. Financial impact (ballpark): the one-time 20% concession on an estimated $180k committed capacity = ~$36k concession. My conservative counter (10% one-time) = ~$18k. If we move to an ongoing reduced SLO post-pilot, that would materially increase support cost and potential credit exposure; recommend avoiding that.

Operational risk mitigation we propose:
- Approve a limited availability deviation strictly for the pilot onboarding window only (first 30 days): 99.8% (not 99.5%).
- After 30 days, require 99.9% for the following 60 days; return to standard 99.95% baseline for remainder of pilot.
- Service credit schedule: 0.5% credit for <99.9, 2% credit for <99.8, credits capped at 5% of monthly invoice and a pilot cumulative cap of 10%.
- Require Pelago to opt into our paid onboarding package (4 weeks) to cover integration work; reduces friction and lowers our go-live risk.

Approval request for exec sign-off: if we accept the 10% one-time credit and the onboarding / SLO sequence above, I estimate net present impact under $25k and limited precedent risk if we document as a single-customer exception memo.

Attachments: Pilot_Estimated_Impact_Q4.xlsx

Requesting Marissa’s exec approval to proceed on those terms so I can finalize the redline and engage Legal.

Thanks,
Jonas
Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, elliot.carlson@pelagohealth.com
Date: 2026-12-15T17:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot SLO ask + draft SOW — APPROVED (narrow conditions)

Thanks for the summary. Approving the exception with the following binding conditions (no deviation):
1) Availability path: 99.8% for first 30 days, 99.9% next 60 days, revert to 99.95% thereafter (explicitly codified in SOW).
2) Service credits: as Jonas proposed — capped at 5% monthly and 10% cumulative for the pilot.
3) Commercial concession: approve a one-time 12% credit on committed capacity invoiced month 1 (not 20% / not open-ended).
4) Operational controls: Pelago must sign up for our paid onboarding package and enable KMS + SSO + weekly health reports.
5) Exception memo: Deal Desk to produce a short exception memo (risk, precedence, who approved) and upload to the contract folder in Box. This approval is contingent on Legal signing the SOW redline and an exec ticket filed so Finance can book the credit.

Laura — please prepare the billing treatment (how we apply the 12% credit) and confirm estimated impact; Jonas, once you confirm paperwork I'll route to Legal and Ops for the SOW redline and delivery checklist. Sean — please tell Elliot the approved terms and get a confirmation on pilot start date.

Marissa Cole
SVP, Sales — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
